text: A UDP request can be forged to appear to come from a victim, so that the large reply is sent to the victim instead of the attacker.
explanation: True — this is reflection with amplification. UDP is not authenticated and the source address can be spoofed. DNS gives roughly 28-54x, NTP monlist up to 557x, and memcached up to 51,000x, which produced the 1.35 Tb/s attack on GitHub in 2018.
